_notice: FICTIONAL demonstration content for the Nova Health prototype. The hospital, its departments, locations, timings and extensions are invented and must not be treated as real information.

hospital.name: Nova Health Multi-Speciality Hospital
hospital.opd_hours: Monday to Saturday, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM
hospital.help_desk: Main Reception, Block A, Ground Floor (Ext. 1000)
hospital.visiting_hours: Daily, 4:00 PM to 7:00 PM (one visitor per patient at a time)

how_to_book: Open Appointments in Nova Health, or ask the AI Assistant to help you.
Choose a department, a preferred date and briefly describe the reason.
Submit the request. It is saved with the status Pending.
The hospital reviews the request. It is only an appointment once the hospital confirms it.
what_to_bring: A government photo ID (for example Aadhaar card or PAN card)
Your Nova Health patient card, if you have one
Previous prescriptions, reports and discharge summaries
A list of medicines you currently take
Health insurance card or policy details, if applicable
appointment_guidance.arrival_advice: Please arrive 15 minutes early to complete registration at the Main Reception.
